title: EDGC: Entropy-driven Dynamic Gradient Compression for Efficient LLM Training
abstract: arXiv:2511.10333v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) at scale incurs substantial communication overhead, while static gradient compression cannot adapt to gradient evolution and may degrade model quality. We propose EDGC, an entropy-driven dynamic gradient compression framework that adapts compression ranks to gradient entropy during training. EDGC combines efficient entropy estimation through gradient sampling, a theoretical model relating entropy to compression rank under a bounded-error constraint, and window-based rank adjustment across pipeline stages. Experiments on 32-V100 and 64-H100 GPU clusters training GPT2 models with 2.5B and 12.1B parameters show that EDGC reduces communication latency by up to 46.45% and end-to-end training time by 16.13%, while maintaining model quality.

translated_title: EDGC：面向高效大语言模型训练的熵驱动动态梯度压缩
translated_abstract: 大规模训练大语言模型（LLM）会带来巨大的通信开销，而静态梯度压缩无法适应梯度的演化，且可能降低模型质量。我们提出了EDGC，一种熵驱动的动态梯度压缩框架，可在训练过程中根据梯度熵自适应地调整压缩秩。EDGC结合了三项技术：通过梯度采样实现的高效熵估计、在有界误差约束下将熵与压缩秩相关联的理论模型，以及跨流水线阶段的基于窗口的秩调整机制。在由32块V100和64块H100 GPU组成的集群上训练参数量分别为25亿和121亿的GPT2模型的实验表明，EDGC最多可将通信延迟降低46.45%，将端到端训练时间缩短16.13%，同时保持模型质量。
tldr: EDGC提出了一种熵驱动的动态梯度压缩框架，根据训练过程中梯度熵的变化自适应调整压缩秩，在保持模型质量的同时将大语言模型训练的通信延迟最多降低46.45%、端到端训练时间缩短16.13%。
en_tdlr: EDGC is an entropy-driven dynamic gradient compression framework that adaptively adjusts compression ranks based on gradient entropy during training, reducing communication latency by up to 46.45% and end-to-end training time by 16.13% while maintaining model quality in LLM training.
